macroModel.rateFormula: Sum of each 3/6/12-month driver composite multiplied by its allocation-relevance weight.

drawdownModel.formula: Fund composite DD = 60% observed-history/proxy maximum drawdown + 40% forward-looking median drawdown. Portfolio DD uses allocation-weighted composites and the correlation matrix.

slides.title: ATRAM Peso Money Market Fund
slides.thesis: Liquidity and short-duration ballast. This is the portfolio's drawdown and funding sleeve, not its long-run growth engine.
facts: Use a forward model; do not backfill

slides.title: ATRAM Global Technology Feeder Fund
slides.thesis: The concentrated growth sleeve. It feeds Fidelity's Global Technology Fund; sector and FX concentration mean it is constrained by the portfolio risk budget.
facts: Feeder launched Apr 2018; no 10Y observed record

slides.title: ATRAM Nasdaq Equity Income Feeder Fund
slides.thesis: The income sleeve feeds JPMorgan's Nasdaq Equity Premium Income Active UCITS ETF. Covered calls may exchange some upside for option premium income; payouts are not guaranteed.
facts: JPM Nasdaq Equity Premium Income Active UCITS ETF

monitor.trigger: Not relevant if cash yield, after current verified fees, is persistently below the required liquidity return for 2 quarterly reviews; or fund mandate/duration changes materially.
monitor.cadence: Daily source check; monthly rate/holdings review; quarterly mandate review

monitor.trigger: Not relevant if its target-fund mandate drifts materially; all-in verified fees erode the approved forward return; or 12-month earnings/capex stays <3.0 and composite DD breaches the active cap.
monitor.cadence: Daily source check; monthly macro/fee review; quarterly target-fund and overlap review

monitor.trigger: Not relevant if covered-call implementation or distribution policy changes materially; option-premium conditions stay weak while upside participation is sacrificed; or verified fees defeat the forward median case.
monitor.cadence: Daily source check; monthly distribution/volatility review; quarterly ETF prospectus review
